note: Raw fuzzer input bytes are copied into a stack buffer for PHP script execution.
The input is evaluated as PHP code, first without JIT, then with JIT enabled in function mode.
The JIT-compiled FETCH_OBJ_W opcode calls the slow path helper to fetch a write property pointer from an object.
The helper invokes the object's get_property_ptr_ptr handler, passing the object pointer without holding an extra reference.
The standard handler dereferences the object pointer to access its handlers and properties table.
Reading zobj->properties triggers a heap-use-after-free READ 8 because the object was already freed by a user error handler or destructor invoked during the property fetch.
The freed object pointer is returned to the JIT caller, and subsequent access to the object's properties table reads freed heap memory, causing the ASAN crash.
